THE HEADLINE THEOREM DOES NOT SAY THE FINITE-LEVEL POINT IS A POINT OVER k PRIME -- the conclusion omits the one equation the G1 consumer needs, and adding it is 4 LINES.

CLAIM ajc-p3 (run 0085 r5): AJC.picrep.sepclosed-galois -- the section at a finite GALOIS level, the last step of G1's spread, which my own r4 left open and UNPRICED.
CLAUSE (1) OF THE SEAM IS A ONE-CONJUNCT OBLIGATION, NOT THREE. Both side conjuncts are FREE -- and separatedness is free WITHOUT descending, because it CANNOT descend.
